hook_plan.narration: Warning! AI just got a terrifying new name, and it changes everything!
hook_plan.image_description: Extreme close-up of a person's cybernetic eye reflecting complex binary code, digital glitch effects across the screen, dramatic red side lighting, intensely focused expression.

thumbnail_plan.image_description: A hyper-realistic 3D render of a glowing, intricate quantum computing chip at the center, surrounded by swirling holographic data streams, deep blue and purple cyberpunk neon lighting, 8k resolution.
thumbnail_plan.reasoning: The term 'SUPER INTELLIGENCE' immediately conveys massive impact and future technology, paired with a visually striking, high-contrast futuristic chip to grab both tech enthusiasts and general curiosity for clicks.

segments.text: On a recent Monday, former President Trump addressed tech leaders, announcing a significant renaming. He now refers to Artificial Intelligence as 'Super Intelligence'.
segments.image_prompt: A sleek, modern conference room with a holographic podium. The words 'Super Intelligence' are projected in glowing text, with data streams reflecting in the air, cinematic lighting.

segments.text: Trump emphasized this redefinition signifies AI's future impact, claiming it will be 'much bigger than the internet'. This statement highlights its profound, widespread potential.
segments.image_prompt: A visual representation of global network lines converging into a central glowing 'Super Intelligence' core, contrasted with stylized historical internet symbols, showcasing vast scale and connectivity.

segments.text: The renaming from 'Artificial' to 'Super' isn't merely semantics. It shifts perception, hinting at capabilities beyond human replication, towards advanced cognitive functions.
segments.image_prompt: A stylized human brain silhouetted against a backdrop of complex, glowing neural networks, illustrating enhanced cognitive abilities, digital data flowing, intense focus.

segments.text: Experts define Super Intelligence as intellect far surpassing the smartest human minds. It implies a leap in problem-solving, learning, and creative thought processes.
segments.image_prompt: A highly detailed, glowing fractal pattern rapidly self-generating and evolving on screen, symbolizing exponential intelligence growth and complexity, cyberpunk neon lighting.

segments.text: This reclassification forecasts transformative changes across industries. Imagine healthcare diagnostics, climate modeling, and scientific discovery accelerated exponentially by these systems.
segments.image_prompt: A composite image showing medical scans, climate charts, and a scientist's lab setup, all with dynamic, glowing data overlays powered by a central AI hub, reflecting data.

segments.text: Acknowledging 'Super Intelligence' sets a new baseline for public and policy discussions. It frames AI development as humanity's most significant technological frontier.
segments.image_prompt: A diverse group of people with expressions of intense focus and serious thought, looking up at a vast, glowing holographic projection of interconnected data, cinematic lighting.

segments.text: If useful, please like and subscribe!
